note: The two sets are nearly identical in content, values, units, and quotes, covering the same drivetrain properties from both the prose and Table 5-1. Both redundantly list the fully-deployed brake torque twice (once from prose, once from the table), and both keep the gearbox no-frictional-losses condition and the brake time-lag condition. The only differences are trivial wording variants (e.g., 'Rated Speed' vs 'Rated Rotor Speed' for the rotor, and whether 'fully-deployed' is carried in the attribute name or the conditions field), with no misread or invented values in either set. Both equally omit the driveshaft natural frequency and 5% critical damping ratio facts.
